---
# HOW TO START A NEW EDITION
# 1. Copy this folder to conferences/<year>/ (drop the leading underscore).
# 2. Fill in the fields below; the archive listing and the "facts" strip use them.
# 3. Add images/, files/ and (during the event) photos/ next to this file.
# 4. Point the "Conferences" menu in _quarto.yml and the hex logo in
#    _brand.yml at the new edition.
title: "uRosYYYY"
subtitle: "The Use of R in Official Statistics · DD–DD Month YYYY · City, Country"
description: "Hosted by <institution>."   # one sentence; shown on the listing card
lang: en
image: images/urosYYYY-hex.png
image-alt: "uRosYYYY hex sticker"
# aliases: [/conferenceYYYY.html]         # keep old r-project.ro URLs working

year: YYYY
dates: "DD–DD Month YYYY"
location: "City, Country"
venue: "Venue name, address"
host: "Host institution"
event-format: "On-site"                   # On-site | Virtual | Hybrid

contact:
  secretariat: "urosYYYY [at] example.org"
gdpr:
  controller: "Romanian National Institute of Statistics"
---
